title: DFS follows one branch to a leaf, backs up to the latest fork, then tries the next
caption: Looking for a root-to-leaf path that spells 1 → 1 → 5. The highlighted nodes are the current path (the call stack).

frames.text: dfs(1) at the root: 1 matches sequence[0]. path = [1].
Go left first: dfs(1 left) matches sequence[1]. path = [1, 1].
dfs(2) ✗ and dfs(3) ✗: neither is 5, so each returns at once. The left 1 has no child left to try; it is popped and path = [1].
Back at the root's fork, go right: dfs(1 right) matches. path = [1, 1] again. Then dfs(4) ✗.
dfs(5) ✓: it matches the last value and is a leaf. path = [1, 1, 5] is found.
